description: Detect live website vulnerabilities and security flaws in GitHub repositories using automated DAST and SAST scanning. Safeguard applications by identifying exposed secrets, insecure dependencies, and common code patterns prone to exploitation. Receive structured fix plans with precise code remediation steps to resolve identified risks and improve security posture.
